messages:
DeployBot: ALERT: reranker-service v2.1.0 rollout in us-east shows elevated retry-rate and worker restarts. Auto-rollback attempted but blocked by maintenance lock.
Rina Kaur: I see the spike on p95 and retries graph. Maintenance lock due to kernel patching — that explains blocked auto-rollback.
SRE Oncall: kernel logs show OOM kills during large-batch reranks after quant-mode change. Looks like kvcache pressure.
Ops Mateo: I can do a targeted rollback of reranker in us-east to v2.0.4. Need release-manager override to bypass maintenance lock.
CS Priya: three customers on hosted in us-east reported transient errors. They want a rollback.
Release Manager Sam: granting emergency override. +1 for targeted revert of reranker in us-east only. Keep global rollout paused.
Rina Kaur: plan: 1) Ops run one-at-a-time image revert 2) annotate release with rollback tag rollback-1749991110 3) suppress auto-rollouts for reranker in us-east for 30m 4) write short release note blurb and customer comms.
Ops Mateo: running commands now:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/reranker-service reranker=redwood/reranker:v2.0.4 --context=us-east
kubectl annotate deploy/reranker-service rollback=1749991110 --context=us-east
```
Ops Mateo: rolling update started, 1 pod at a time. ETA ~8m.
SRE Oncall: observing logs; first replaced pod stabilized, error rate decreasing. Will monitor p95 and OOMs.
DeployBot: MANUAL ACTION recorded: override-rollback by Ops Mateo at 1749991152. Auto-rollback suppressed due to maintenance lock earlier.
Ops Mateo: rollback finished at 1749991196. All us-east reranker pods now at v2.0.4.
CS Priya: notified affected customers with short note and ETA for safe re-upgrade after fix. They acknowledged.
Runtime Dev Leo: filed ticket RED-8012 for quant-mode kvcache regression and flagged for enhanced canary metrics.
Release Manager Sam: updated release metadata and added line to release notes: "Targeted rollback of reranker in us-east due to memory regression; manual override executed when auto-rollback was blocked by maintenance window."
Rina Kaur: assigning Rina + Leo to immediate postmortem. Include timeline, maintenance-lock analysis, and a runbook change to allow emergency rollbacks during scheduled infra ops with explicit guardrails.
SRE Oncall: will keep elevated watch for 90m. If any regressions, escalate to oncall.
DeployBot: NOTE: auto-rollouts for reranker in us-east suppressed for 1800s to avoid flip-flop.
Rina Kaur: thanks team — good quick coordination. :white_check_mark:
